## Purpose
"Architecture — Mistral Dynamic Agent Tools": the system as built. It covers the deployable units and their boundaries, the runtime flows that cross them, and the design constraints that follow. It is explicitly not a roadmap.

## Accuracy
- **Largely accurate on the core design:** natural-language request → agents, tools and workflows created on demand; backend versus Tool Service; local DAG engine versus Mistral Workflows.
- **Last changed 2026-08-07,** so it predates later work: accounts and workspaces, the vault, background runs, graph RAG and process knowledge, the deploy stack and `frontend-3`.

## Used by
Developers and reviewers who need the big picture.
